C1334.title: ClickFix Campaigns Distribute MacSync Infostealer via Fake AI Tool Installers
C1334.summary: In March 2026, researchers identified three distinct ClickFix attack campaigns using fake AI tool installers as lures to deliver the MacSync information-stealing trojan. The attacks rely entirely on user interaction, tricking macOS users into copying and executing malicious commands rather than exploiting vulnerabilities.
